acceptance.explicitTitle: session.title writes the title and the lock flag in one call; locked sessions reject rename; ExplicitTitleWriteLocksOnDemand
acceptance.performance: limit clamps to 1..200, page carries total; 500-row store pages 50 rows with correct total inside the harness budget; HistoryLimitClampsAndReportsTotal, PagedHistoryStaysFastWithCorrectTotal
